title: Phoedox – documentation that knows how everything fits together
description: Phoedox connects pages, decisions, processes, customers, systems and devices into a knowledge graph that people and AI use over MCP. Self-hosted or in the cloud, built for GDPR-compliant operation.

hero.label: Documentation with a knowledge graph
hero.title: Documentation that knows how everything fits together.
hero.lead: Customers, contracts, processes, decisions, servers and devices: Phoedox connects all of it into one graph. You find answers in seconds, and any AI with MCP looks things up in it instead of guessing.
hero.note: Open source (AGPL) · Docker, Helm or Home Assistant add-on · export your data at any time

ai.label: AI knowledge base
ai.title: The source your AI can rely on.

ai.1: Connect. Enter the MCP address and sign in with your own account.
ai.2: Look it up. The AI searches, follows edges, reads skills and live values.
ai.3: Write along. Changes arrive as suggestions; a person approves them.
ai.q: # What do we need to check at Müller before the update?

priv.label: Privacy and data location
priv.title: Built for GDPR-compliant operation.
priv.lead: Documentation often holds exactly the things that must not leak. So you decide where your data lives, and Phoedox passes on nothing you have not released.
priv.1.d: With your own instance, all data stays on your server. Phoedox needs no account with us, and the connection to the plugin store can be switched off.
priv.2.d: Where the data of Phoedox Cloud is stored and which service providers are involved is set out in full in the privacy policy.
priv.3.d: Passwords hashed with Argon2id, credentials and plugin secrets stored encrypted, tenants separated in the database with row-level security.
priv.4.d: A connected AI sees only what the person may see. Per account you decide whether it may only read or also write suggestions.
priv.5.d: Every change by a person, AI, plugin or agent is logged with its author; older versions can be restored.
priv.6.d: Export projects as a ZIP with Markdown and import them into another instance, from the cloud to your own and back.
priv.site: This website uses no tracking and loads fonts and icons from its own server. The only cookie remembers the language you chose.
pub.label: Publishing
pub.title: Go public, on your own domain too.
pub.lead: Combine one or more projects into public documentation. Variables, live values and private entries stay out. Point your domain at it with a CNAME; the certificate is issued automatically.
pub.name: Publication “Docs”
plug.label: Plugins
plug.title: Bring in what your tools already know.
plug.lead: Every plugin runs sandboxed and tells you up front what it may do. You install it with a link that opens the plugin settings of your own instance.

questions.label: What do we need to check at Müller before the update?
questions.answer: The maintenance contract allows a window on Saturdays from 6 pm. The skill Update procedure says: check the backup job first, then tell Anna Müller.

questions.label: What goes down when the UPS runs empty?
questions.answer: srv-mueller-01 hangs on the office UPS. That stops the backup job and the maintenance contract with customer Müller. Remaining runtime according to the plugin: 38 minutes.

questions.label: Who sets up accounts for new people?
questions.answer: According to Onboarding, Jonas Weber sets up the accounts; he also looks after srv-mueller-01. The page is required reading; 4 of 6 have confirmed it.
